versions.localizedDescription:
Orivyn 0.1.1 build 11 — unfinished unsigned iOS 26+ preview.

Adds a separate confirmation before replacing conversation history from a backup. Preserve-local remains the default. Canceling a pending replacement leaves stored history unchanged; stale picker callbacks after navigation are rejected, and a confirmed replacement is consumed once. Existing native tools, vision and transcript features are retained.

Verification of integrated source 5c5ca7fbfe812386fb6afb8bc20778c374e0f525: 152 macOS host XCTest cases passed with no failures or skips, including synthetic local-file fixtures exercising the production confirmation state → coordinated file reader → SQLite chain (not AppModel or Files UI) for replacement, cancellation/preservation and corrupt input. iOS build-for-testing passed, which compiles but does not execute the iOS tests. Portable Foundation and source-contract checks passed separately. A prior controlled simulator comparison verified Files presentation and cancel/navigation only, not selected-file replacement. Actual selected-file confirmation UI, external file-provider access grants and physical-iPhone behavior remain unverified.

Package source 3f96a41b363e3b663f69497fef4bd698fb1fa514 changes only the build number and packaging tooling from that tested integration. The prior build 10 simulator/native-route evidence belongs to its older source and was not rerun for this preview; it is not full verification of build 11.

Known limits: generic autonomous requests can still respond before completing requested reads. Vision remains experimental, with a known mixed-shape counting failure in the earlier frozen evaluation. Automatic live sync remains disabled. Models download separately; no weights are bundled. Optional remote providers may charge. Process termination can leave a temporary model snapshot using additional storage. Device installation/signing refresh, voice and memory/thermal performance are unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0 and is not an OpenAI product.

Integrated host and iOS compile evidence: https://github.com/R347H4CK3R/Orivyn/actions/runs/43722288003
Package gate: https://github.com/R347H4CK3R/Orivyn/actions/runs/43723555076

The pinned combined runtime rebuilt successfully, portable package/graph checks passed, and the Release device build and independent unsigned IPA inspection passed.

Orivyn 0.1.1 build 10 — unfinished unsigned iOS 26+ preview.

Includes the reviewed native read route, the LFM2.5-VL-1.6B vision option, and the history-import presentation fix. Automatic live sync remains disabled while pairing and scheduling integration are tested.

To use the reviewed native route, explicitly download/select Qwen3 · 1.7B · Q4_K_M, create a Read messages plan for one exact quoted conversation title and one message index, review the scope, approve, then Run. Other tasks/models use their existing routes. Vision requires an explicit model download and review of the displayed model license; no model weights are included in this IPA.

Known limits: generic autonomous tasks may still answer before completing requested reads. Vision remains experimental: the frozen synthetic evaluation scored 9/10, with mixed-shape counting still failing; one app-level simulator smoke does not establish broad image understanding. This candidate does not provide automatic live sync. A process termination can leave a temporary model snapshot using additional storage. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, voice, memory/thermal behavior and device runtime are unverified.

Verified application source 03b9c5cc0f96e0dce332e0e3c36460a9346ff304: 1,040 native core tests, 1,035 passed, five explicit skips, zero failures. Separately, the actual reviewed Q4 workflow passed with three native decisions and a fresh verification marker; the LFM simulator smoke passed with cleanup acknowledged. These ran on an ARM64 iPhone 16 Plus simulator with iOS 26.0.1. Generic agent and standalone suggestion gates were not run for this candidate. Selected UI fixes passed earlier scoped tests; the full combined UI suite was not rerun.

The first package attempt stopped at its dirty-source guard. Tooling-only corrections produced final package source 40844c2d96441b8183f231fb27e8a52faa1db80c; all app and app-test files are unchanged from the tested source. The clean Release device build, unsigned IPA validation, exact bundled LFM license check and runtime provenance checks passed. Native tests were not repeated on that tooling-only packaging commit.

Orivyn 0.1.1 build 9 — unfinished development preview

Unsigned ARM64 IPA for iOS 26 or later. Your installer must sign it for your account/device. Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately.

Includes the current local assistant, reviewed read workflows, native tools and local image analysis, and new history receive/recovery protections. Automatic live sync is still disabled. New experimental engine, vision model, pairing and scheduler improvements are NOT included.

Exact-source verification: 1,032 native core tests executed, 5 skipped, zero failures; unsigned device build and IPA structure/resource checks passed. UI-0 passed. UI-2 failed waiting for a hittable Files Cancel control after Photos cancellation; general production autonomy failed the required search/read grounded-answer test. Other UI/model results are separate, not full acceptance.

General autonomy and broad vision remain unreliable. Intermittent Files UI issues remain. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, voice, memory/thermal behavior and runtime remain unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0.

Orivyn 0.1.1 build 8 — development preview

Unsigned ARM64 IPA for iOS 26 or later; Installation and any required signing are handled by your installer. Strata installation/runtime has not been verified. Preserve the existing app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately.

Includes the current local assistant, reviewed read-workflow fixes, native tools/vision runtime, and durable text-sync storage. Live automatic sync is not enabled. General unreviewed autonomy and broad vision reliability remain unfinished. A UI test found that New conversation did not clear the previous response after a real model reply. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, memory/thermal behavior and runtime acceptance remain unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0.

This package passed unsigned device compilation, runtime archive validation, IPA structure/resource checks and independent identity/hash inspection. Native unit/UI tests were not run for this exact package. Parent implementation fb146910 separately passed 1,014 native tests (5 skipped, zero failures), all 129 portable persistence tests and six reviewed-read real-model cases; its general-agent and one UI test failed. Vision's frozen synthetic baseline matched 8/10 cases. None of these results certifies general autonomy, reliable broad vision, automatic sync or physical-device readiness.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
